description.ja: 『ARMORED CORE VI FIRES OF RUBICON』のアイテムが『30 MINUTES MISSIONS』シリーズで商品化！
description.en: “ARMORED CORE VI FIRES OF RUBICON” items are commercialized in the “30 MINUTES MISSIONS” series!

description.ja: シリーズのキーコンセプト「シンプル組み立て」「カスタム遊び」のもと、展開状態を再現可能な実弾オービットを含めた武器群がオプションパーツセットで登場！
description.en: Based on the series' key concepts of "simple assembly " and " custom play," a group of weapons including a live bullet orbit that can reproduce the deployed state is now available as an optional parts set!

description.ja: • 武器の内容は「HG-003 COQUILLETT」「SG-027 ZIMMERMAN」「BO-044 HUXLEY」「BML-G3/P04ACT-01」。
description.en: • Weapons include "HG-003 COQUILLETT ", " SG-027 ZIMMERMAN ", " BO-044 HUXLEY ", and " BML-G3/P04ACT-01".

description.ja: • 装備する際に左右で形状が変わる武装は再現用のパーツがそれぞれ付属し、選択式で組み立てが可能。
description.en: • Weapons that change shape on the left and right when equipped come with parts for reproduction, and can be assembled selectively.

description.ja: • 「BO-044 HUXLEY」は選択式で展開状態を再現可能。別売りの「アクションベース6」を使用することで展開状態でのディスプレイが可能。
description.en: • "BO-044 HUXLEY " can be selectively reproduced in its unfolded state. By using the separately sold " Action Base 6", it can be displayed in the unfolded state.
